notablePrerequisites:
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
description:
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a token copy of Sparring Mummy with haste.
The Sparring Mummy token enters the battlefield, untapping Jaxis.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Sparring Mummy token, adding {R}.
The Sparring Mummy token dies, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
